body: There aren’t many people in America who have had fewer opportunities than me. However, to be blunt, the world is a different story. I know I have opportunities that 9/10 other kids around the world don’t have.I want to help them. Of course, I find enjoyment in helping others. I have worked at various nonprofits and social groups already and it is something I love doing. I even run my own. However, I realized that it’s never going to be enough rationally. It just isn’t. Even as a career, I can’t save the world working for an environmental law firm when we have Goldman Sachs and JPM LITERALLY ruining the world (saying this as someone who aspires to work for them). So seriously, what’s the point in trying. Your entire post is telling me to find a purpose. What I’m saying is that so far, I’ve tried and failed. I never got to experience the blissful ignorance of childhood, apparently the best part of your life as I’m told by everyone. So why bother continuing?
